'''Silk Touch''' is an [[enchantment]] that makes blocks drop themselves. It works as in vanilla, but [[Matcha Flavoured]] makes it exclusive with the tool intrinsics of [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]], and gives it to [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] tools as an intrinsic.

== Obtaining ==
* The [[Prayer of Eros]], a crafted [[blessing]].
* [[Shakudo equipment|Shakudo]] tools have Silk Touch as an intrinsic.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Shikudo, a gold-copper alloy that cleanses malefic, steals life from mobs, and whose tools have silk touch as an intrinsic.}}</ref>
* Random enchanted books in chests and fishing treasure, and trial chamber vaults.

== Behavior ==
Silk Touch is exclusive with Fortune and with the electrum tool intrinsic, which share the <code>#minecraft:exclusive_set/mining</code> tag.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/enchantment/exclusive_set/mining.json}}</ref> The adamant tool intrinsic, which smelts mined blocks, lists Silk Touch in its own exclusive set.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/enchantment/exclusive_set/intrinsic_mining.json}}</ref>

Its anvil cost multiplier is 1, down from 8.
